claims.title: GELU and SiLU conservation-law completeness
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Reconstruct the arbitrary-width Taylor and pole certificate, check exact Fraction ranks, and reject a repeated-gamma rank-loss control.
claims.limitation: Finite checks support the derivation but do not replace a proof assistant.

claims.title: SwiGLU conservation laws
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Derive the inverse-scaling symmetry and iff gradient condition, then audit paper-width blocks with an independent non-law control.
claims.limitation: The model-scale audit corroborates the structural result; it is not the universal proof by itself.

claims.title: MHA and RoPE conservation laws
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Apply exact Q/K, V/O, and RoPE group actions, then audit the displayed invariants at paper-width settings with a non-conserved control.
claims.limitation: The broader no-additional-laws classification is not separately machine-formalized.

claims.title: Normalized-sigmoid MoE laws coincide with softmax laws
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Construct an exact d=3 normalized-sigmoid counterexample where the claimed gate-row sum has gradient-flow derivative 9/250, and confirm it with an independent checker and softmax control.
claims.limitation: The contradiction targets the normalized-sigmoid portion; softmax and expert-level SwiGLU laws remain separate.

claims.title: Figure 2 O(tau^2 k) scaling on named training runs
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Complete discretization, exact-configuration, resource, and assumption-preserving falsification routes without substituting a toy run for the named campaign.
claims.limitation: The authors' training implementation, raw trajectories, and authorized H100-scale execution are unavailable.
